text:
Sam (Support): Heads-up — concurrent onboarding failures across 3 enterprise trials: Arcadia, CoreX, BeaconPay. All clients hitting 500s on /v1/provision and sessions stuck "activation_pending". Escalating to CS because Arcadia renewal check is in 5 days and this is high risk.

Priya (CS): Noted. Can you drop the exact error lines and sample request IDs? I’ll loop Jordan + Riley and we’ll prepare a comms plan.

Sam (Support): Pasting logs/snips: 
```
2026-03-10T08:12:34Z ERROR provisioner: failed to allocate tenant quota -> 500 request_id=req_kj3b9 tenant=arcadia
2026-03-10T08:12:36Z ERROR kv-cache: lease timeout request_id=req_kj4c2 tenant=corex
2026-03-10T08:12:37Z WARN proxy: upstream returned 502 for webhook -> beaconpay
```
Also customers report webhook retries and some front-end UX saying "Activation delayed".

Jordan (CS Manager): @Priya @Riley — priorities: Arcadia (trial ends in 5d, ARR ~$120k) and CoreX (QBR scheduled in 10d). We need a comms + enablement push within 24h, and to flag renewal risk in CRM now.

Priya (CS): Sam, any ETA from eng? @eng-oncall-bot can you confirm status?

eng-oncall-bot: We have a degraded provisioning worker pool caused by a scheduler regression in the rollout. Mitigation: scaling worker pool x2 and rolling patch. Expected recovery in ~30-60m. Will update when fully recovered.

Riley (Enablement): I can carve out 1:1 enablement slots and a short troubleshooting runbook. Draft outreach message below — PTAL:

"Hi <Name>, quick update: we've identified an internal provisioning issue affecting some activations. We’re accelerating activations and are scheduling a live provisioning check-in at 10:30am PST. We'll follow up with next steps and any compensation. Apologies for the interruption"

Jordan (CS Manager): Good. Also prepare to offer extended trial days or account credit for Arcadia given timing. Loop legal if needed.

Sam (Support): Triage notes / temporary workaround: manual provisioning from admin console succeeds for some tenants. Steps: 
```
1) Admin UI -> Tenants -> Create -> select 'manual-provision'
2) CLI: ./tools/provision --tenant <tenant_id> --force
```
This can unblock high-touch accounts while eng rolls the fix.

Priya (CS): Riley — can you own outreach for Arcadia and BeaconPay? Jordan — I’ll coordinate with Sales on QBR schedule changes. Sam — please confirm when manual-provision works end-to-end and any edge cases.

Riley (Enablement): I’ll run the manual provision for CoreX and join the call at 10:30am PST. I’ll also attach a one-pager with step-by-step screenshots.

Sam (Support): Status update: patch rolled, worker pool scaled. Activation success climbed to ~98% over last 15m. Still monitoring for residual 500s and webhook 502s.

Priya (CS): Thanks. Action items: 1) Priya — outreach + renewal flag + legal for credits; 2) Riley — enablement + live session + run manual-provision for CoreX; 3) Sam — continue monitoring & post final recovery note; 4) Sales — adjust QBR agenda. Jordan to publish comms template in #customer-success-ops.

Jordan (CS Manager): I'll post a short comms template and incident summary in #customer-success-ops and create a quick follow-up doc for Sales. Thanks team. :thumbsup:
